program_level.purpose: This COBOL copybook defines data structures for handling claim-related transactions and transfers, likely used for claims processing or data migration between systems
program_level.content: Contains two main data structures: DIPWCC00-DATA and DIPWCC00-DATA-R (a redefine of the first structure). The first structure stores claim-related fields including source/object claim numbers and combination details. The redefine structure appears to handle transaction counts and date ranges.
program_level.usage: This copybook is included in other COBOL programs that need to process claim transactions or transfers. The comment references program DICPCC00 which likely uses this copybook for data loading operations.
